entries.what: Rochelle drives the van to Tamsen Valley, parks in Lot C by 8:15, and eats her blue-cooler leftovers in the car. Before anatomy she works on cranial nerves, making up a mnemonic from the names of her family members.
entries.outcome: She has a mnemonic built from Andre, Aaliyah, DeShawn and Keisha that she can actually remember.

entries.what: Sits through Dr. Okoye's 9 a.m. anatomy lecture next to Linh, then goes through her index cards in the library.
entries.outcome: Finishes the nerve cards before her back starts to flare.

entries.what: At home she does the 9 p.m. kitchen-table study session after dinner. Andre is wiped out from his overtime day.
entries.outcome: Goes over cards until 10:30 and then goes to bed.

entries.what: Rochelle's registration window opens, so she logs in on the new refurbished laptop and registers for Anatomy II and Microbiology. Microbiology is full and puts her on waitlist spot #4.
entries.outcome: Anatomy II is confirmed and she is waitlisted #4 for microbiology.

entries.what: Goes to intro chemistry at 11 a.m., then stops by Denny's office to ask about microbiology waitlist odds.
entries.outcome: Denny says waitlists usually move in the first week, and she checks it against Denny's map.

entries.what: Skips nothing on her Tuesday list. She drives Loretta to the pharmacy at 3:30 and attends Pedro's study group on the way when time allows.
entries.outcome: She gets Loretta's refills sorted and attends only the end of study group.

entries.what: After Wednesday anatomy and lab, Rochelle finds she lost two points on a lab quiz. She drafts an email to Dr. Okoye asking her to review the scoring, wanting it firm but polite, because she wants to keep her B.
entries.outcome: Sends the email after trimming it down.

entries.what: Eats lunch in the van in Lot C, then stops by Ruiz Family Market for chicken for Sunday batch cooking.
entries.outcome: Spends under her budget.

entries.what: Evening at home with the family. Aaliyah leaves for her Ridgeline shift and Rochelle quizzes DeShawn on his homework between her own cards.
entries.outcome: Everyone fed and out the door.

entries.what: Morning walk on the Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk for her back, then Thursday intro chemistry at 11.
entries.outcome: Back feels loose through class.

entries.what: Keisha calls on her 10 a.m. dispatch break and chats about Thanksgiving dishes.
entries.outcome: Keisha agrees to bring greens and rolls.

entries.what: Takes the online medical terminology work at night after the kids are settled, timing herself with the kitchen timer.
entries.outcome: Finishes the module without freezing.

entries.what: Friday anatomy at 9 with Linh beside her, reviewing nerve names right before class.
entries.outcome: Gets through the quiz review feeling ready.

entries.what: Gets Okoye's reply about the lab quiz points and reads it on the walk back to the van.
entries.outcome: Okoye will recheck the quiz.

entries.what: Fridays evening, she picks up groceries and sorts out the Thanksgiving list on the fridge calendar with Andre.
entries.outcome: List done, assignments written in pen.

entries.what: Works her Saturday senior lunch shift at the Vinca Avenue Community Center, 8 to 1.
entries.outcome: Earns her $18 an hour and chats with regulars.

entries.what: Drops by the Thanksgiving food drive pickup line near Our Lady of the Marsh and collects groceries for Loretta.
entries.outcome: Brings the bags to Loretta's fourplex.

entries.what: Evening at home with a rewatched hospital drama while folding laundry.
entries.outcome: Laundry done, back eased.

entries.what: Sunday batch cooking: red beans and rice for the week with a baked chicken.
entries.outcome: Containers stacked for the week of overtime.

entries.what: Skips church to prep, while Aaliyah is at her Delgado Park soccer game.
entries.outcome: Takes a short break for her.

entries.what: Afternoon, Andre sleeps through football. Rochelle sits at the kitchen table and checks the microbiology waitlist spot, still #4.
entries.outcome: Still #4; she goes through anatomy cards.
